item.description: Learn how to embed live MuleSoft Anypoint snapshots directly in Confluence pages using MuleSight. This tutorial covers macro types, display modes, and how to build a macro coverage page that replaces static screenshots with real-time API data.

item.title: The Complete Guide to Confluence Approval Workflows (2026)

item.title: Your MuleSoft Documentation Is Already Stale
item.description: MuleSoft API documentation goes stale the moment you hit publish. Here is why that happens, what it costs your team, and how to fix it with live Confluence macros.

item.title: Version-Aware Approvals in Confluence: Why Approved Pages Need Version Tracking

item.title: Detecting MuleSoft Environment Drift Using Confluence
item.description: MuleSoft environment drift — where dev, staging, and production diverge — causes silent failures. Learn how MuleSight detects drift across MuleSoft environments directly inside Confluence.

item.description: Step-by-step guide to setting up multi-step approval workflows in Confluence using ApprovalFlow. Learn how to configure sequential approval stages, assign approvers, and track page approvals with a full audit trail.
